title: Morning crossing
note: A short invented chat. Scored spellings are in the replaced turns. One spelling is only in the kept tail.

messages.content: The morning crossing has to leave on time for the school run.
The 07:15 from North Quay is the one that connects. The 06:40 was cancelled for the season. The fare is £4.60 each way.
Book it under the name Pellam, not under Grey Harbor Tours.
Pellam it is. I am dropping Grey Harbor Tours from the note.
The red kiosk sells tickets after nine.
